### threshold testing
```{r}


### threshold testing

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Define thresholds
thresholds <- 10^seq(-6, -1, by = 1)   # from 1e-6 to 1e-1
thresholds <- c(thresholds, 0.05, 1)      # add 0.05 explicitly if desired
results <- lapply(thresholds, function(th) {
  all %>%
    group_by(Accession, phage_spor_host) %>%
    summarise(
      pos.ParS.hit = max(ifelse(!is.na(q.value) & q.value <= th, 1, 0)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(phage_spor_host) %>%
    summarise(
      Phage_has_ParS = sum(pos.ParS.hit),
      total.phage = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ParS.pos.perc = Phage_has_ParS / total.phage * 100,
      threshold = th
    )
}) %>% bind_rows()

#results.fig <- merge(results, meta.cats, by="phage_spor_host")

# Plot
p<- ggplot(results, aes(x = threshold, y = ParS.pos.perc, color = phage_spor_host)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +  # log scale for q-values
  labs(
    x = "False Positive (q-value) Threshold",
    y = "% Phages with 1 or more ParS Binding Site"
  ) + labs(linetype = "Phage Lifestyle", color="Bacterial Host") +geom_vline(xintercept = 1e-4, linetype = "dotted") #+ theme(legend.position="none")
p + theme(legend.position = c(0.125, 0.82)) #+ scale_color_manual(values = rev(pal3))


#ggsave(here("02_motifs/ParS/QValueTresh1e4_line.png"),width=7, height=7)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
ParS.hits2 <- select(ParS.hits, Accession, motif_id, start, stop, motif.mdpt,score, strand)
ParS.hits2$strand <- ifelse(ParS.hits2$strand=="-", -1, 1)


ParS.hits2 <- ParS.hits2 %>%
  group_by(Accession) %>%
  mutate(motif_id = paste0(Accession, "_ParS_", sprintf("%02d", row_number()))) %>%
  ungroup()


motifs <- select(ParS.hits2, Accession, start, stop, strand, motif_id)
colnames(motifs) <- c("PHAGE", "motif_start", "motif_end", "motif_strand", "motif_id")
motifs <- as.data.table(motifs)

ORFs <- select(func1, Accession, gene_start, gene_end, protein_id, gene_strand)

colnames(ORFs) <- c("PHAGE", "OSTART", "OEND", "ORF_ID", "orf_strand")
ORFs   <- as.data.table(ORFs)

setkey(ORFs, PHAGE, OSTART, OEND, orf_strand)


library(data.table)

find_motifs_flanks_final <- function(motifs, orfs, 
                                     motif_id_col = "motif_id",
                                     motif_strand_col = "motif_strand",
                                     orf_strand_col = "orf_strand",
                                     require_same_strand = FALSE) {
  # defensive copies
  mot_dt <- as.data.table(motifs)
  orf_dt <- as.data.table(orfs)

  # build motif table keeping motif_id and optional strand
  M <- mot_dt[, .(motif_id = get(motif_id_col), PHAGE, motif_start, motif_end)]
  M[, MID := floor((motif_start + motif_end) / 2)]

  if (motif_strand_col %in% names(mot_dt)) M[, motif_strand := as.character(mot_dt[[motif_strand_col]])]
  else M[, motif_strand := NA_character_]

  # build ORF table keeping strand if present
  G <- orf_dt[, .(PHAGE, OSTART, OEND, ORF_ID)]
  if (orf_strand_col %in% names(orf_dt)) G[, orf_strand := as.character(orf_dt[[orf_strand_col]])]
  else G[, orf_strand := NA_character_]

  # optionally require same strand by creating a shared STRAND column
  if (require_same_strand) {
    M[, STRAND := motif_strand]
    G[, STRAND := orf_strand]

    cont <- G[M, on = .(PHAGE, STRAND, OSTART <= MID, OEND >= MID), nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE]
    cont_agg <- cont[, .(
      CONTAINING_ORF = paste(unique(ORF_ID), collapse = ","),
      CONTAINING_STRAND = paste(unique(STRAND), collapse = ",")
    ), by = .(motif_id)]

    up <- G[M, on = .(PHAGE, STRAND, OEND < MID), mult = "last",
            .(motif_id = i.motif_id, UP_ORF = ORF_ID, UP_STRAND = STRAND, UP_DIST = pmax(0L, i.MID - OEND))]
    down <- G[M, on = .(PHAGE, STRAND, OSTART > MID), mult = "first",
               .(motif_id = i.motif_id, DOWN_ORF = ORF_ID, DOWN_STRAND = STRAND, DOWN_DIST = pmax(0L, OSTART - i.MID))]
  } else {
    cont <- G[M, on = .(PHAGE, OSTART <= MID, OEND >= MID), nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE]
    cont_agg <- cont[, .(
      CONTAINING_ORF = paste(unique(ORF_ID), collapse = ","),
      CONTAINING_STRAND = paste(unique(orf_strand), collapse = ",")
    ), by = .(motif_id)]

    up <- G[M, on = .(PHAGE, OEND < MID), mult = "last",
            .(motif_id = i.motif_id, UP_ORF = ORF_ID, UP_STRAND = orf_strand, UP_DIST = pmax(0L, i.MID - OEND))]
    down <- G[M, on = .(PHAGE, OSTART > MID), mult = "first",
               .(motif_id = i.motif_id, DOWN_ORF = ORF_ID, DOWN_STRAND = orf_strand, DOWN_DIST = pmax(0L, OSTART - i.MID))]
  }

  # assemble (left join so motifs with no matches remain)
  out <- merge(M, cont_agg, by = "motif_id", all.x = TRUE)
  out <- merge(out, up, by = "motif_id", all.x = TRUE)
  out <- merge(out, down, by = "motif_id", all.x = TRUE)

  # final tidy columns, ensure character NAs
  out[, .(motif_id,
          PHAGE,
          motif_start,
          motif_end,
          MID,
          motif_strand = if ("motif_strand" %in% names(out)) motif_strand else NA_character_,
          CONTAINING_ORF = ifelse(is.na(CONTAINING_ORF), NA_character_, CONTAINING_ORF),
          CONTAINING_STRAND = ifelse(is.na(CONTAINING_STRAND), NA_character_, CONTAINING_STRAND),
          UP_ORF = ifelse(is.na(UP_ORF), NA_character_, UP_ORF),
          UP_STRAND = ifelse(is.na(UP_STRAND), NA_character_, UP_STRAND),
          UP_DIST,
          DOWN_ORF = ifelse(is.na(DOWN_ORF), NA_character_, DOWN_ORF),
          DOWN_STRAND = ifelse(is.na(DOWN_STRAND), NA_character_, DOWN_STRAND),
          DOWN_DIST)]
}


res <- find_motifs_flanks_final(motifs, ORFs)

```

```{r}
res$hit <- 1
res <- select(res, motif_start, motif_end, MID, PHAGE, motif_id, CONTAINING_ORF, UP_ORF, DOWN_ORF, hit)

res.contain <- select(res, PHAGE, motif_id, CONTAINING_ORF, hit)
res.contain <- na.omit(res.contain)


res.contain.multigene <- res.contain[grepl(",", res.contain$CONTAINING_ORF), ]
res.contain.multigene <- res.contain.multigene %>% separate(CONTAINING_ORF, into=c("Cont1", "Cont2"), sep = ",", extra="merge", remove = TRUE)
res.contain.multigene <- res.contain.multigene %>% pivot_longer(cols=c("Cont1", "Cont2"),  names_to = "gene")
res.contain.multigene <- select(res.contain.multigene, PHAGE, motif_id, value, hit)
colnames(res.contain.multigene) <- c("PHAGE", "motif_id", "CONTAINING_ORF", "hit")

res.contain <- res.contain[!grepl(",", res.contain$CONTAINING_ORF), ]

res.contain <- rbind(res.contain, res.contain.multigene)


res.flank1 <- select(res, PHAGE, motif_id, UP_ORF, hit)
colnames(res.flank1) <- c("PHAGE", "motif_id", "FLANK_ORF", "hit")
res.flank2 <- select(res, PHAGE, motif_id, DOWN_ORF, hit )
colnames(res.flank2) <- c("PHAGE", "motif_id", "FLANK_ORF", "hit")
res.flank <- rbind(res.flank1, res.flank2)
res.flank <- na.omit(res.flank)




ParS.contain <- res.contain %>% 
  group_by(CONTAINING_ORF) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_containParS = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    gene_containsParS = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

ParS.contain <- ParS.contain %>% rename(protein_id = CONTAINING_ORF)


ParS.flanks <- res.flank %>% 
  group_by(FLANK_ORF) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_flankParS = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    gene_hasflankParS = sum(hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

ParS.flanks <- ParS.flanks %>% rename(protein_id = FLANK_ORF)


ParS.hits.merged <- bind_rows(ParS.contain, ParS.flanks)
ParS.hits.merged[is.na(ParS.hits.merged)] <- 0

ParS.hits.merged$gene_assocParS <- 1
```
